result_summary.title: Event Tracker Unresponsive / Full Outage
result_summary.description: The Event Tracker service in US-East production appears to be unresponsive, with reports of a full outage. No events are being tracked or displayed. We are unsure if this is a direct failure of the tracking service or if it is related to data freshness issues preventing the UI from updating. Currently, no users are being actively impacted based on initial reports, but the lack of service availability is concerning for upcoming monitoring needs.
